result.summary: Found 1 issue: the 'Fastest near you' carousel renders the same restaurant card twice, which looks like a data/rendering bug.

issues.description: The first two cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are identical duplicates: same bowl photo, same '15-25 min' badge, same 'Green Bowl Poké' title, and same '€0.90 delivery' text, so one restaurant occupies two slots.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list before rendering the carousel so each venue appears only once, and check that the data source is not returning the same item twice.
